concurrentActiveStations.description: 2 SMT lines × 6 stations (Printer, SPI, Fuji 1, Fuji 2, Oven, AOI)

sustainedThroughputTxSec.description: Accommodates 35 components/sec placement rate + continuous SPI/reflow telemetry

p95ReadLatencyMs.description: Genealogy queries, DHR checks, station status refreshes under load

p95WriteLatencyMs.description: Real-time interlocks (/smt/splice-verify, barcode scans, placement events)

databasePoolSaturationPct.description: Maximum 15 active connections on a pool limit of 20 connections

genealogyRecordLoss.description: Zero tolerance. Every placement and splice event must land in canonical log

traceabilityDuplication.description: Idempotency keys must eliminate duplicate ingestion events under retry conditions

serviceRestartRecoverySec.description: Time from SIGTERM to healthy status on /health under load

heapMemoryDriftPct.description: Node.js heap must stabilize after warm-up; no circular reference memory leaks

diskStorageIngestionMultiplier.description: Expected telemetry rate: ~600 MB/day; total growth <= 720 MB

crossStationClockSkewMs.description: Monitored via NTP drift check in station health probe
